desc: In the game the settings page (F1) keeps its Multiplayer tab and rows (co-op, Players, Brothers mode, Duo moves and the rest), while the launcher's Settings has none of them (launcher_mp_no_game, launcher_mp_search): in Rogueport's plaza with co-op on, the page open on Multiplayer lists the tab and draws its rows (TTYD_SETTINGS_TABS_LOG)
log_must: \[settings\] Multiplayer on the game's page: ([5-9]|[1-9][0-9]) rows
log_must_not: \[settings\] Multiplayer on the game's page: not there
